documents.text: ###### Type of the final payload The type of the sent payload (after serialization and going through any [`onSend` hooks](./Hooks.md#onsend)) must be one of the following types, otherwise, an error will be thrown: - `string` - `Buffer` - `stream` - `undefined` - `null`

request.answer: ### onSend If you are using the `onSend` hook, you can change the payload.
